subject: Nimbus pilot capacity coverage and sprint triage
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@nimbus.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus pilot: capacity ask and timing

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team walked away excited. We're trying to lock down capacity planning for our Q4 pilot (internal goal: ramp starting Oct 1). Preliminary forecast attached (Nimbus_forecast_v2.xlsx). Short version: if traffic follows our growth curve, we anticipate a sustained 1.5k rps-equivalent token throughput peak and a smaller evening spike that would benefit from burst slots.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you map that forecast to your Dedicated slot model and indicate the recommended reserved slot commitment for predictable latency?
- What are our options for short-term burst capacity if we need to scale before a longer commit?
- Any suggested cadence for weekly check-ins during the ramp?

We're ready to move quickly provided contract terms are workable; attached is the signed NDA. Can you advise next steps?

Best,
Sara
Head of Platform Partnerships
Nimbus AI

Attachments: Nimbus_forecast_v2.xlsx, NDA_signed.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara@nimbus.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: capacity ask and timing

Sara — thanks for the forecast and NDA. Filing this into the hubspot deal and looping in infra and SalesOps so we can give a concrete capacity recommendation. Quick take from me: we should propose a tiered plan — a modest reserved commit to cover baseline plus a burst pool for the evening spike. Karthik/Marissa/Ben, can you each weigh in on the sizing assumptions below by EOD Wednesday?

My suggested ask for internal triage:
- Baseline reserved: cover 70% of predicted steady-state tokens (gives latency SLO headroom)
- Burst cushion: 20% on-demand (pre-warmed where possible) for 2-hour evening windows
- Canary strategy: roll pilot on 2 smaller regions first, then promote to full US pool

If you need to reframe the forecast differently (tokens vs rps), tell me and I'll get Sara to drop a per-minute example. Meeting cadence: weekly 30-min runway sync through Oct.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: capacity ask and timing

Adding infra sizing detail from my quick pass. I translated the 1.5k "rps-equivalent token throughput" into our slot model with conservative headroom:
- Recommended reserved: 12 GPU slots (p4d equivalent) sustained to hit 70% of forecast during peak windows. That assumes quantized model (8-bit) and our KV cache for prefixes.
- Burst plan: preserve 3 burst slots plus auto-burst to cloud region (subject to availability) for evening spikes — this should handle the 20% transient increase.
- Ops notes: we can pre-warm 2 burst slots 30 minutes before the expected spike if Nimbus can provide a 15-min heads-up webhook.

Open items for Sales/Finance:
- Term length for reserved pricing (monthly vs 6m vs 12m) affects unit rate significantly.
- If Nimbus wants a volume rebate, we need a commit window to size.

I'll put a quick cost delta matrix in the shared drive later today.

-Karthik
Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:51:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: capacity ask and timing

Thanks Karthik — this looks sensible. Finance can support a short-term concession to accelerate the pilot:
- Offer: 10% usage credit for the first 3 months if Nimbus signs a minimum 6-month reserved-commit contract for the 12-slot baseline.
- Requirement: one-time onboarding fee to cover dedicated pool setup.

Marissa, please confirm CS can own the weekly ramp checks and the 15-min spike webhook requirement. If so, I'll draft a term sheet and iterate with legal.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Finance
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sara Patel <sara@nimbus.ai>, Nimbus AI Sales <sales@nimbus.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 18:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Nimbus pilot: capacity ask and timing

Sara — short summary and next steps: 

1) Recommendation (from infra): 12 reserved GPU slots + 3 burst slots. Pre-warm plan: Redwood can pre-warm 2 burst slots on 30-min notice; Nimbus to provide a 15-min webhook.
2) Commercials (from Sales Finance): 10% usage credit first 3 months if Nimbus commits to a 6-month reserved contract for the baseline slots. One-time onboarding fee applies.
3) Ops cadence: weekly 30-min runway sync (Tuesdays 09:00 PT) during ramp window starting Sep 15 — Marissa to own.

Proposed next steps for Nimbus to accept:
- Confirm willingness to commit to 6 months for the baseline slots (reply to this thread)
- Provide a sample 15-min webhook payload or agree to a manual pre-warm call during the first two weeks
- Confirm legal can accept a term sheet with the onboarding fee and the early usage credit

If you agree, Ben will circulate a first draft term sheet by Thursday and I'll schedule the weekly kickoff.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this into the runway.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
